meta.parties: Abeywardene Et Al. v. Tyrell Et Al

rules.statement: Upon the execution of a conveyance in favor of donees, property received as exchange becomes subject to any fidei commissum attached to the original property.
rules.supporting_quote: "Any property taken in exchange for any property exchanged under the provisions of this Ordinance shall become subject to the same entail, fidei commissum, or settlement, as the property for which it was given in exchange was subject to at the time of such exchange."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Any property taken in exchange for any property exchanged under the provisions of this Ordinance shall become subject to the same entail, fidei commissum, or settlement, as the property for which it was given in exchange was subject to at the time of such exchange.
